ask.printHead: Battery Ventures · Questions to ask · {{s:brand.name}} · Oct 4, 2026
ask.clipboard:
Questions to ask Battery Ventures, from {{s:brand.name}}

1. Down rounds, bridges, pay-to-play: In your last 3 down or flat rounds, did you lead, follow or walk?
2. Follow-on and pro rata: What share of your seed/A companies did you reinvest in at the next round, including the strugglers?
3. Replacing founder-CEOs: When did you last back replacing a founder-CEO, and how did it happen?
4. Board seat & consent rights: Will you take a seat at my stage? Which consent rights do you require?
5. Competitor overlap: Does any partner sit on the board of a company that competes with me?
6. Reserves for this check: Which fund is this check from, and how much is reserved for follow-ons?
7. Foreign or sovereign LPs: Are there sovereign or foreign-state LPs in this fund?
8. References from failures: Give me 2 founders whose companies failed with you on the board.
